mapper.select: SELECT draft_reserveinfo_num AS draftReserveinfoNum, merchant_uid AS merchantUid, user_code AS userCode, onedayclass_num AS onedayclassNum, selectedDate AS selectedDate, onedayclass_price AS onedayclassPrice, status AS status, created_at AS createdAt FROM draft_reserveinfo WHERE onedayclass_num = #{onedayclassNum} AND selectedDate = #{selectedDate} AND user_code = #{userCode} AND status = 'READY' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draft_reserveinfo (merchant_uid, user_code, onedayclass_num, selectedDate, onedayclass_price) VALUES (#{merchantUid}, #{userCode}, #{onedayclassNum}, #{selectedDate}, #{onedayclassPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id as history_id, h.onedayclass_num as onedayclassNum, h.onedayclass_price as onedayclassPrice, dr.draft_reserveinfo_num as draftReserveinfoNum, dr.merchant_uid as merchantUid, dr.user_code as userCode, dr.selectedDate as selectedDate, dr.status as Status FROM onedayclass_history AS h LEFT JOIN draft_reserveinfo AS dr ON dr.onedayclass_num = h.onedayclass_num WHERE h.history_id = ( SELECT MAX(history_id) FROM onedayclass_history WHERE onedayclass_num = h.onedayclass_num ) AND h.onedayclass_num = #{onedayclassNum} and dr.status='READY' AND dr.user_code =#{userCode}
